summary: Transcripts read machine wakes as one row, each message as one object, and each episode as trigger, work and outcome; the web gateway asks for message authors

replay.detail: Web UI and client derivations only; no replay or rebuild.

schema.detail: No storage changes. A new shared transcript fixture (fixtures/clients/transcripts/wakes) pins daemon wakes with and without author.

compatibility.detail: The web gateway now adds conversation-message-participants.v1 to every client read and WebSocket upgrade, so mail headers carry author and recipients. Daemons without the capability ignore it; the web then treats a header with a recipient and no writer as Fractal's. @fractal/views and fractal-conversation-ui read author before from, so a wake reads as an event on every client.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous transcript rendering and feature header.
